title: المعادلة الكيميائيّة
sourceImageAvailability: Four official Grade 8 Chemistry textbook page scans (pp. 36–39: image-1.png through image-4.png) were supplied and audited directly on 2026-10-25. Following repository policy, bitmap scans are not stored in Git; every printed element is traced in src/data/curriculum/lesson6SourceLedger.ts.

items.coverage: Printed title «6 المعادلة الكيميائيّة», the exact printed heading «الأهداف:» with its four learning objectives (O1–O4), and the exact printed heading «الكلمات المفتاحية:» («المعادلة الكيميائيّة الموزونة – دلالات الرّموز.») are reproduced verbatim without adding unprinted introductory sentences inside textbook-verbatim blocks.

The introductory iron-rebar rusting sentence and both «أتساءل :» prompts are reproduced verbatim; the rusting rebar photograph is documented honestly via reference card book-l6-p36-rust-bars (status: decorative).

Section heading «كتابة المعادلة الكيميائيّة:», «أجرب وأستنتج :» apparatus list, and all three numbered procedure steps are reproduced verbatim. The test-tube figure is reconstructed as SVG (source-figure-p37-zinc-hcl) preserving the three printed labels («زنك», «حمض كلور», «H₂») and the lit match flame; platform lab notes (such as the hydrogen pop sound) are explicitly separated from printed text.

All four «أُلاحظُ وأستنتِجُ :» bullets, the five-row physical-state/condition table (s, ℓ, aq, g, Δ), the printed LTR word equation, and the unbalanced symbolic equation Zn(s) + HCl(aq) → ZnCl2(aq) + H2(g) are reproduced faithfully.

The three atom-count fill-in prompts on p. 37, the HCl coefficient prompt on p. 38, the balanced Zn + 2HCl equation, and the three-row verification table (Zn: 1/1, Cl: 2/2, H: 2/2) are implemented with interactive checks.

Both «أستنتج :» bullets and the exact printed lines and all six symbolic equations of «تطبيق محلول :» (initial skeleton Al(s)+HCl(aq) → AlCl3(aq)+H2(g), the four printed intermediate coefficient-balancing equations including 3HCl and 2×3HCl, and the final balanced equation 2Al(s)+6HCl(aq) → 2AlCl3(aq)+3H2(g)) plus its printed word equation are reproduced verbatim, strictly separated from platform pedagogical commentary in worked-example-al-hcl-explained.

All three «نشاط :» items (C + O2, Na + ZnSO4, Al + S) and all three «تعلّمتُ :» bullets are reproduced verbatim. Activity 2 includes an explicit platform scientific note clarifying that free metallic Na reacts vigorously with water in real aqueous solutions.

All seven «أختبر نفسي :» items (Question 1: 3 word-to-balanced-equation items; Question 2: 4 equation-balancing items) are reproduced in exact reading order with interactive controls, full step-by-step platform solutions, and explicit platform scientific/safety notes on the theoretical aqueous-sodium items (Na + CH3COOH(aq) and Na + CuSO4(aq)).
